ui.upload.format: Please enter the value in the format 506.388.

lern.hinweis.automatik_html: Auto-reading starts shortly and then runs every {n} minutes – or read right away with Read camera now.
lern.hinweis.kamera_html: Read camera now fetches a fresh image from the camera.
lern.hinweis.keine_kamera_html: For automatic reading, first select the camera on the Admin page.
lern.hinweis.keine_kamera_option: For automatic reading, first configure a camera (option kamera or variable KAMERA).
lern.neuere: A newer reading exists – learning still uses exactly this image.
lern.bild_alt: Camera image with ROIs and processed digits
lern.label: Correct meter reading on this image (m³, 3 decimals)
lern.lerneffekt_aus: Learning is off: the image is only archived and will be learned at the next start with learning on.
adm.leer.text: Import an existing model (ZIP) below under “Back up & transfer”, or teach camera images with the correct meter reading on the training page until every digit 0–9 has been learned once. If your camera sits differently from the default, set the ROIs first.
adm.automatik.text: Reads the camera image regularly and writes only certain, plausible values to Home Assistant: forward only, and no faster than water can flow.
adm.automatik.kamera_label: Select camera – the preview shows whether it is the right one
adm.automatik.stand_label: Set the meter reading by hand, e.g. after replacing the meter or if “lower than the previous reading” is reported permanently
adm.lernen.upload_label: Learn your own image with a known meter reading
adm.ablesungen.text: The last 20 since start. The number opens the reading on the training page.
adm.vorlagen.text: This is how the matcher sees each learned digit. If a tile does not fit its row, it comes from a wrongly learned image: tap the tile, then correct or delete the training image below.
adm.lernbilder.text: Newest first, showing the counter. If a value is wrong, correct or delete it. With learning on, the templates are rebuilt right away.
adm.sichern.text: The model consists of all training images and templates. It is also part of every Home Assistant backup of the add-on. An export can be moved back and forth between the add-on and Docker.
adm.sichern.import_label: Import model: an export from the admin page or a ZIP of the data folder
